method: CERF Food Security consolidated score using IPC 60 percent, FAO/ASAP block 20 percent, and SOFI 20 percent. Missing blocks are removed and remaining weights are renormalized.

historical_parity.workbook: 260810 CERF UFE 2026-I CIRV and Funding Analysis

availability_rules.IPC_FEWSNET_GRFC: Only positive values from 1 to 5 receive weight.
availability_rules.FAO_ASAP: Only positive values 1 or 2 receive weight. Zero is preserved as source evidence but excluded from weighting.
availability_rules.SOFI: Only positive values up to 100 receive weight. Zero, blank, and missing values are excluded.
availability_rules.no_evidence: A country with no usable Food Security evidence receives a score of zero.

shock_block_method: FAO and ASAP share the 20 percent block equally when both receive weight. One source receives the full block when the other is unavailable.

YEM.reason: CERF manual adjustment reflecting the likely prevalence of IPC Phase 5 in DFA-controlled areas where current IPC analysis was unavailable.
